Uyir Movie Reviews Highlight Generic Plot and Dated Approach

Reviews for the movie 'Uyir' indicate a generally uninspired reception, with critics describing it as a generic crime drama and a run-of-the-mill police procedural. Despite reportedly being based on a remarkable real story, reviewers suggest that the film fails to translate its potential for exploring human emotions effectively onto the screen. The movie features Roshan Mathew and Shruthy Menon.
